search_intent: Map playlist mood descriptions to colour palettes
summary: Map an emotive playlist description to the colour palette archetype it evokes.
problem: The application receives a short free-text atmosphere description written by a user or playlist curator. Traditional metadata like genre, tempo, or release year does not reveal whether a playlist feels like a neon synthwave night or a golden sunset afternoon. The application must evaluate the ambient description against candidate palette definitions and choose the matching archetype or select a neutral default theme. Downstream code then uses this evaluation to update player UI styling dynamically.
input_description: A short free-text playlist atmosphere description.
decision: Choose the colour palette archetype (neon synthwave, earthy acoustic, pastel lofi, golden sunset) the description evokes.
action: Apply the matching colour theme to the player interface.

seo.title: Map Playlist Mood Descriptions to UI Color Palettes
seo.description: Evaluate emotive playlist atmosphere descriptions and map them to visual color palette archetypes for dynamic music player UI styling.

intro: Static genre tags fail to capture evocative user playlist descriptions like 'midnight drive through rainy neon streets'. This example evaluates free-text atmospheric descriptions against defined visual themes to select an appropriate color palette archetype for UI rendering.
solution: In these observed examples, the application submits the atmosphere_description text field under the palette_archetype choice question. For inputs describing rainy synth streets or warm coastal sunsets, the returned evaluations selected the neon_synthwave and golden_sunset archetypes, whereas generic focus text yielded unclassified_neutral. Downstream application code can read the returned choice to update player interface themes or load matching CSS palette variables. While the API provides the visual classification judgment based on criteria, application code executes the actual theme routing and determines local UI fallback policies.
limitations: This single Choice question returns one primary option per request, though applications can use independent Noul questions if a workflow requires multi-label attribute scoring for complex playlist descriptions.

The unclassified_neutral label provides an explicit no-match option in criteria, but you can implement application-side confidence thresholds or fallback default themes before applying visual updates.
Categorizing user text into visual archetype options provides a semantic mood triage rather than authoritative music metadata verification or guaranteed visual suitability.

palette_archetype.instructions: Evaluate the playlist atmosphere description in state and select the single visual color palette archetype it best matches, or unclassified_neutral if none match.

criteria.neon_synthwave: Nighttime, rainy streets, glowing neon lights, futuristic or retro electronic mood.
criteria.pastel_lofi: Cozy room, chill beats, soft warm pastel colors, rainy afternoon or coffee aesthetic.
criteria.golden_sunset: Warm acoustic sunbeams, summer afternoon, golden hour glow, open road outdoor vibes.
criteria.unclassified_neutral: The description is generic, missing atmospheric visual detail, or does not clearly evoke any defined palette archetype.

demo.title: Floating Atmosphere Particle Cluster
demo.concept: Playlist atmosphere descriptions trigger glowing colored particles that float into liquid containers proportional to matching palette probabilities.
demo.interaction: The visitor inputs text such as 'rain splashing on city neon at 2 AM' and presses analyze.
demo.visual: Particles glow and bubble into container vats representing each palette, filling them according to returned probabilities while a background moon or sun illuminates based on the nighttime judgment.

palette_category.instructions: Determine which color palette archetype best fits the playlist_description field in state.

criteria.neon_synthwave: Midnight dark backgrounds with neon violet, electric blue, and magenta highlights.
criteria.earthy_acoustic: Natural organic browns, moss greens, and muted terracotta tones.
criteria.pastel_lofi: Soft vintage pastels, faded pinks, cream, and sky blue hues.
criteria.golden_sunset: Warm sun-drenched golden hours, amber, and deep orange tones.
criteria.unclear_atmosphere: The text is ambiguous, non-descriptive, or lacks identifiable aesthetic themes.

is_nighttime.instructions: Does the playlist_description field in state depict a nighttime or dark atmospheric setting?

criteria.true: Mentions night, late hours, dark roads, midnight, shadows, or neon darkness.
criteria.false: Mentions daylight, morning, sun, bright skies, afternoon, or midday activities.
